## Notes

- Air Bombardment and Secondary Barrage Targets Table, 41.5 (41.51), chart page 12 (jp2 106, printed sideways). Read twice, from the archive.org scan and the community chart PDFs (Shared Charts.pdf p. 12): 374 result cells and 33 column headings compared, 0 differ. Every column of every target group covers the two-dice range 11-66 exactly once.
- columns: one per printed column; enter by bomb points, torpedo points (41.72) or barrage points (secondary barrage targets), whichever the attack delivers. to null: and more.
- The barrage heading of the tenth column is printed '1+' on both scans, and the eleventh has none; '1+' is recorded as printed (it reads as 21+ in sequence). The footnote marks a and b on the torpedo and barrage headings have no footnote text on the page.
- result_kind: levels, capacity or efficiency levels lost (air facilities 41.36, ports 41.39B); percent, of each supply in the dump (41.35) or of the convoy's cargo (41.66); effect, no-effect or reduced/destroyed (41.37, 41.38); number, battalion-equivalents pinned (combat units, 41.31), truck points (41.32), AA TOE strength points (41.33) or damage points (ships, 41.34).
- dice is the two-dice range read in order (11 to 66) giving that row in that column; null where the column has no such result.
